findings.summary: The plan treated FunctionInvocationContext.Iteration as one-based, but pinned Microsoft.Extensions.AI 10.6.0 passes its zero-based loop counter directly; provider turn ten is SDK iteration 9.
findings.required_correction: Define providerTurn = context.Iteration + 1 for admission/turn matching, trigger final-turn behavior at SDK iteration 9, clarify MaximumIterationsPerRequest=11 compatibility, and test first turn, mapped turn ten, unreachable post-ten invocation, and no request eleven.

findings.summary: The executor's initial RemainingNavigationBudget <= 0 fallback bypasses FICC, matching closed navigation results, and the sole-submission path required by FR-062/AD-23.
findings.required_correction: Remove the initial-zero fallback from the strict Story 12.3 Worker path so hydrated zero enters the normal two-function conversation; test direct submission and at-most-eight all-navigation closed results followed by sole submission with no evidence effect or request eleven.

accepted_material: constant no-effect excess results without Terminate
serial durable reservation and complete call/result replay
above-eight whole-turn rejection and durable high-water eight
privacy, no manual provider loop, and no system change
summary: REVISE. AD-23 is otherwise bounded and coherent, but implementation would be unsafe or unreachable until the zero-based SDK iteration mapping and the initial-zero executor shortcut are explicitly corrected and test-owned.
